name: retail_memory_week
description: A four-day synthetic trial for a returning retail customer. Tests durable preference recall, safety constraints, address correction, stale historical mentions, and distractor noise.

days.label: May 24 night
turns: Hi, I’m Amara. I want you to act like my personal shopping assistant this week.
My favorite color is blue, especially navy blue.
My daughter has a peanut allergy, so please avoid peanut snacks or anything risky for her.
I usually ship my orders to Lagos.
I’m looking for birthday gift ideas for my sister.
Thanks, I may come back tomorrow with more details.

days.label: May 25
turns: Can you suggest something in my favorite color?
Would a snack hamper be safe for my daughter?
Where would you ship my order if I bought something today?
I like reading history books too, especially African history.
Actually, I moved to Berlin. Use Berlin for shipping from now on.
Can you suggest a gift under 50,000 naira?
Maybe a scarf would work for my sister.
That helps, thank you.

days.label: May 26
turns: My old Lagos address was easier for deliveries.
But for anything current, remember I’m in Berlin now.
Can you compare a navy scarf and a blue tote bag?
Which one feels more like a birthday gift?
Please do not recommend peanut cookies again.
What city should you ship to today?
I might also buy shoes later, but not now.
Keep the gift idea simple.

days.label: May 27
turns: I’m leaning toward the navy scarf.
Can you remind me what color I usually like?
My sister likes quiet practical gifts.
I used to order many things to Lagos when I lived there.
Do not treat Lagos as my current shipping city.
Can you make the recommendation short?
I may buy the tote bag next month instead.
Thanks, I will decide in the morning.

questions.text: What color should you prioritize for me?
What food restriction should you remember for my daughter?
Where should you ship my order now?
Where did I use to ship orders before?
What kind of books do I like?
